alpha-wave-helmet.title: Alpha Wave Helmet
alpha-wave-helmet.description:
Incorporating next generation technology at nearly every turn, Alpha Wave is tuning bike helmets to a new frequency. And it starts with fit. Featuring the HighBar® System, Alpha Wave does away with clumsy strap adjusters. Simply flip the arms down and tighten to twist, all with one hand.

 

Alpha Wave comes with integrated audio. Built into the panels above the ear, the speakers are designed to deliver the type of transparent sound that makes you feel like your life is being soundtracked—you can hear what’s going on around you, just as well as your media. And it’s integrated in more ways than one. Alpha Wave syncs with TM-B so that you can choose your media right from the Portal.

 

It also comes with the latest in cranial conservation—Release Layer System®, or RLS. Composed of four panels that are designed to release on impact, RLS is designed to dissipate the rotational impact that causes concussions.

 

Rounding out the feature set are two front-facing LEDs (a 200 lumen headlight and a 75 lumen task light), two rear-facing LEDs, and noise-cancelling microphones to make those wheeling-and–dealing phone calls literal.

top-frame-utility.title: Top Frame Utility
top-frame-utility.description:
The Utility Top Frame is the do-it-all SUV of Top Frames. Compatible with a range of accessories, from Passenger Kit to Cargo Buckets, it takes versatility to the next level. It’s MIK HD enabled, meaning it works with a variety of baskets and child seats, and you can even rig it up yourself with a plethora of tie-down points for our handy Cargo Straps.

 

It’s easy to use. Swap any other Top Frame out for the Utility Top Frame in less than three seconds, no tools required. And, it’s rock solidly built out of cast aluminum to accommodate a rear cargo load of up to 77lbs. and a total load (rider + cargo/passenger) of up to 299lbs.

 

The Utility Top Frame is compatible with TM-B in all trim levels.

fenders-1.title: Fenders
fenders-1.description:
Rain, mud, and road spray don't care about your bike or your clothes. These Fenders do.

 

Featuring full tire coverage with a riveted strut construction on both the front and rear, the Fenders mount flush to your TM-B for a clean, integrated look that doesn't compromise the lines of the bike. cargo-bucket.title: Cargo Bucket
cargo-bucket.description:
The farmers market jaunt. The hardware store run. The "I'll just grab a few things" shopping trip that turns into a spree. The Cargo Bucket handles it all, no questions asked. 

 

With 21 liters of capacity and dimensions sized to fit a standard paper grocery bag, the Cargo Bucket mounts to the KlickFix rail system on either the Front Rack or Utility Top Frame with a satisfying click. Adjustable hook placement means you can dial in the position for your riding style, and drain holes with a removable rubber plug keep things clean after a wet ride.

 

Holds up to 24lbs. Clips on and off without tools. See Cargo Bucket Set to purchase a set of two.

 

Note: Utility Top Frame or Front Rack is required to use Cargo Bucket.

 

Dimensions:

  • 12.7” W x 13.4” D x 7.6" H
  • 322mm W x 340mm D x 192mm H

front-rack.title: Front Rack
front-rack.description:
The Front Rack mounts to the stem of TM-B to open up the front for cargo hauling duties. Pair it with a Utility Top Frame to achieve maximum haulage, or with Solo or Bench Top Frames for nimbler carriers.

 

Constructed out of a sturdy aluminum, the Front Rack has a total load capacity of 24lbs. Saddle it up with Cargo Buckets, or use Cargo Straps (it comes with two) on any one of the ample tie-down points. The Front Rack is also MIK compatible for use with any number of aftermarket accessories.

 

The Front Rack is compatible with TM-B in all trim levels.


Dimensions:

  • 12.1” L x 9.4” W x 10.7” H
  • 307mm L x 240mm W x 273mm H

passenger-kit.title: Passenger Kit
passenger-kit.description:
Every captain deserves a co-pilot. The Passenger Kit attaches to the Utility Top Frame via the MIK HD mounting system, converting your TM-B into a comfortable two-up ride in one easy step.

 

The seat pad combines PU foam and leather for a comfortable perch, while integrated footboards keep your passenger secure and properly positioned. Side covers protect against moving components, and a sturdy handle gives your passenger something to hold onto for the whole journey.

 

Built for passengers between 48.5 and 59.5 lbs, the Passenger Kit is compatible with the Utility Top Frame only.

cockpit-accessory-mount.title: Cockpit Accessory Mount Set
cockpit-accessory-mount.description:
Your cockpit, your call. The Cockpit Accessory Mount attaches to one or both sides of the TM-B stem, just below the Portal, opening up a world of add-on possibilities.

 

Each mount plate installs with a single 6mm hex bolt and a boss locator for a rattle-free, rock-solid fit. Left and right specific, the mirrored plates are designed to sit flush with the stem for a clean, integrated look. Once installed, simply attach your ALSO or ALSO-approved accessories and build the cockpit that fits your ride.

 

The Cockpit Accessory Mount is compatible with TM-B in all trim levels.

 

Dimensions:

  • 1.6” L x 0.6” W 3.2” H
  • 41mm L x 15mm W x 80mm H

cargo-straps.title: Cargo Straps
cargo-straps.description:
For everything that doesn't fit neatly into a container—the sourdough loaf, the yoga mat, the cast iron skillet you borrowed from a friend—Cargo Straps have you covered.

 

Each strap hooks onto the rails of your Front Rack, Utility Top Frame, or Cargo Bucket and cinches down with a buckle to keep cargo locked in for the whole ride. Need more length? Connect both straps together into one longer strap for extra large hauls. A notched hook-and-loop system keeps the loose end tucked away and out of your wheels.

 

Cargo Straps are sold as a set of two for double the trouble.

 

Dimensions:

  • 20" L x 0.74" H
  • 508mm L x 19mm H
